The facility has emergency plans and procedures in place, however it has not completed a documented annual review of
those plans. A documented review of the facility contingency plan is required and helps ensure that the facility has
planned for emergencies or disasters (one which could reasonably be anticipated and expected to be detrimental to the
good health and well-being of the animals in their possession). Ensure to review and update the contingency plan and
document the annual review of the contingency plan as required.
***Correct by 10/28/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
